card.essence: Mercury transforms healthy cells into inflamed, necrotic wrecks, producing profound anaemia and decomposing blood. The lymphatic system, glands, mucous membranes, bones, and all tissues are affected. The patient is a 'human thermometer'—sensitive to both heat and cold, with profuse, offensive sweats that bring no relief, and all symptoms markedly worse at night. Tremors, weakness, and foul secretions pervade the clinical picture.
card.sides: Right-sided (lying on right side aggravates respiratory symptoms; right lower chest; pain below right breast to scapula)
card.thermal: Ambithermal (sensitive to both heat and cold)

keynotes.text: Profuse, oily perspiration without relief; patient worse during sweating
All symptoms worse at night, from warmth of bed, and from damp cold weather
Sensitive to both heat and cold; 'human thermometer'
Breath, excretions, and body smell foul; offensive odour pervades
Tremors everywhere; trembling from least exertion, especially hands
Tongue heavy, thick, yellow, flabby, teeth-indented
Salivary secretions greatly increased; fetid, bloody, coppery, metallic taste
Never-get-done feeling with stools; painful tenesmus worse at night
Greenish, bloody, slimy discharges; pus thin, greenish, putrid, streaked with blood
Glands swell every time patient takes cold; glandular swellings

modalities_better.text: Cold water (itching and burning of female parts)

mentals: Thinks he is losing his reason
physicals: Parts much swollen with raw, sore feeling
Tendency to suppuration; pus thin, greenish, putrid
Ulceration of mucous membranes; irregular edges, bleeding
Gums spongy, recede, bleed easily; teeth loose, tender, elongated
Stool greenish, bloody, slimy with pain and tenesmus; never-get-done feeling
Cough worse at night, from warmth of bed; yellow muco-purulent expectoration
Skin almost constantly moist; vesicular and pustular eruptions
Jaundice; liver enlarged, sore to touch
Speech difficult due to trembling tongue
clinical: Secondary syphilis with febrile chloro-anaemia, mouth/throat ulcerations, falling hair
Hereditary syphilis: bullae, abscesses, snuffles, marasmus, stomatitis
Suppurative processes with thin, greenish, fetid pus
Rheumatic fever with profuse unrelieving sweat worse at night
Iritis with hypopyon; parenchymatous keratitis of syphilitic origin
Dysentery with bloody, slimy stools and tenesmus
Catarrhal conditions with acrid, profuse, greenish discharges

differentials.note: Lycopodium cannot lie on left side (respiratory); Merc. cannot lie on right side
Both have suppuration and chilliness, but Hepar more sensitive to cold air and touch; less profuse sweat
Both have splinter-like pains and syphilitic manifestations; Nit-ac has more irritability and fears death
Both have changeability and glandular swellings, but Puls. is warm-blooded, thirstless, mild; Merc. has foul odours and profuse salivation

cautions: Persistent dryness of skin contra-indicates Mercurius
Lesions produced by Mercury very similar to those of syphilis; indicated in secondary and hereditary syphilis
All Mercury symptoms worse at night and during perspiration
Powerful drug affecting every organ and tissue; transforms healthy cells into inflamed necrotic wrecks
